description: Turn a photo into a BrickYourFace brick mosaic. Returns a watermarked preview image of what the finished mosaic will look like, its size and price, and a private link where the person can review it and buy the kit. Provide the photo as image_url (a public https link to the image file) or image_base64. Best results: one person or pet, close-up, well lit.

boards_tall.description: Optional: baseplates down (default 1). At most 12 baseplates in total.

boards_wide.description: Optional: baseplates across for a bigger mosaic (default 1).

image_base64.description: The photo as base64 (optionally a data: URL), if there is no public link. Keep it under ~4 MB.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the photo (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC).

size_id.description: Optional baseplate size id from get_brick_mosaic_options. Default: the classic 15 x 15 in.

name: create_brick_mosaic_preview
title: Turn a photo into a brick mosaic preview
